page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a woodcut initial V at the start of the first paragraph. The heading "AD LECTOREM." is centred above the text. No margin notes. A gathering signature stands at the foot, left of centre.

main_text.head: AD LECTOREM.
main_text.p: Vjus libri minax inscriptio, te invitat Lector candide, ut vel injurium ulturus, vel ineptum irrisurus videas; visum judices, non ante quod si feceris, quam à te exoptat benevolentiam, tandem se relaturum speret, ut quem forte risurus accesseris[?], laudes reversus. Laudabis, inquam, vel saltem non improbabis, vel sane, si validis rationibus refelles, tum demum meam agnoscens insc tiam[?], fatebor me tibi devinctum majorem in modum, qui mihi nebulas mente excusseris, quas nulli libri, nulli quos adhuc convenerim hac de re philosophi dissolvere quiverunt: quin eorum responsa, sua levitate majus momentum meis rationibus addiderunt; meaque sententia veritatem magis exploratam fecerunt.

Hac praefatus, precatusque, ne damnes inauditum, rei me accingebam, saltum quem me fecisse jacto reipsa ostensurus: Sed properantem morata est Aristotelis qua maxima est apud omnes doctores authoritas, quos quanti faciam, quamque de illis & aequabiliter sentiam, & reverenter loquar, interest ut noris: ut quorum documentis magna lux in his tenebris mihi refulsit, eorum auspicio, ductuque scias moliri me quicquid aggredior; meque eorum argumentis ac rationibus, tanquam machinis potentissimis instructum magnam muri partem, quem quatio, diruturum.
Hac enim semper fuit ea de illis incredibilis doctri-

page.notes: Woodcut initial V at the start of "Vjus", joined to the first word as printed. The phrase "insc tiam" has a gap in the print where a letter seems to be missing, probably "inscitiam"; left as printed with [?]. "accesseris?" ends with a mark that may be a question mark or a printer's mark; uncertain. The word "doctri-" is split as "do" then "ctri-" with no hyphen after "do"; written whole with the hyphen only at the line end. The page ends mid-word, so the paragraph continues on the next page. Spelling of "Hac" and "qua" follows the scan; some accents may be ambiguous at this resolution.
